Hi,
The purchase of Forest made in either iOS or Android is not transferable as Apple and Google sell the apps in their own market. As app developers, we are not in charge of the app-selling process.
You'd need to buy the iOS and Android versions separately, but you'll be able to use the same account on multiple devices on that platform.
- Forest

- Forest

Man tut etwas für sich und die Unwelt! 2,99€ einmalig dafür zu bezahlen ist es auf jeden Fall wert (besonders für die Statistiken) und es ist günstig. Ähnliche apps (z. B. Flipd) kosten monatlich normalerweise um die 5,-€ (und sind oft nicht so gut ausgestattet wie Forest). Runterladen lohnt sich!

text: Ich liebe die App,da sie es wirklich schafft, die Ablenkungen zu beseitigen. Aber mein einziges Problem ist die limitierte Anzahl von pflanzbaren Bäumen. Dieses Feature war der einzige Grund, warum ich mir die Proversion zugelegt habe. Kann es für sowas keine Lösung geben? Wie zum Beispiel, dass die weiteren Bäume selbstständig mit eignem "realem" Geld gepflanzt werden können?
author: Ein Google-Nutzer
developer_reply:
Hello,
Since the cost of planting real trees is covered by the company, complications might arise when users plant too many real trees; the cost can also easily exceed the app's revenue. Therefore, the number of real trees that each user can plant is limited. We hope you understand and will keep looking for other possibilities.
- Forest

Features include a focus timer, statistics tracking, and a collaborative mode for group focus sessions.It useful for not using phones

text: tldr: Misleading advertisment. App penalizes use of the Pomodoro method by requiring 2 hour sessions without breaks for optimal 'reward'. This discourages use of the Pomodoro method. Claims to be a Pomodoro method app, but penalizes users for using shorter focus sessions by providing loaer quality rewards when compared to doing a 2 hour session without breaks. Requiring people to do long focus timers without breaks to get the best 'reward' actively discourages use of the Pomodoro method.
author: Elizabeth Thompson
developer_reply: Hi, sorry to hear about this. We do not penalize anyone for anything. Regardless of focus hours, users are rewarded virtual trees and coins for every session they complete. To encourage users to focus more and stay away from their phone, longer sessions generate more rewards. Pretty trees are worth the effort! :)

text: Ich hatte eine Zeit lang diese App nicht benutzt, da die virtuell gepflanzten Bäume ein wenig zu empfindlich bei meinem alten Handy waren. Dort war es so, dass selbst bei einer Push Benachrichtung von Whats App mein Baum starb. Mit meinem jetzigen Handy habe ich das Problem nicht, es macht sehr Spaß Bäume zu pflanzen. Meine Freunde und ich erstellen oft Räume zu Vorlesungen und erhöhen unsere Produktivität gemeinsam. Erstaunlicher Weise ist es vor allem in Zeiten von Corona sehr schön mit diesen sogenannten Räumen zu Arbeiten(geht einer an sein Handy sterben auch die Bäume der anderen), da wir uns dadurch uns einander auch wieder näher sind ohne uns zu schreiben. Der kauf der Pro Version ist bei 1,99 Euro auch eine sehr gute Anschaffung. Selbst ne Tüte Bon-Bons ist da ja schon teurer. Man kann dann zum einen mit Freunden pflanzen, echte Bäume pflanzen lassen, Tags erstellen (damit man weiß, wie man die Zeit genutzt hat) und und und.... Eine Empfehlung für alle! Wenn ihr euch die App nun wegen meiner tollen Rezession holt könnt ihr gerne diesen Code eingeben bei dem Menü Freunde einladen, auf das Zeichen gehen das wie ein Coupon aussieht und da meinen Empfehlungscode eingeben: 42FSEG2SG (wäre voll cool dann kriege ich ein Birnenbaumhaus wenn das genug machen *___*)

text: This is one of my favorite apps. It has greatly helped my ability to focus. Like many people these days, I checked my phone very frequently; you could say it was obsessive. I scrolled mindlessly on my phone, not really sure what I was looking for. Furthermore, all the doom and gloom on the news probably worsened this feeling. I had trouble focusing on any task, whether it was work or pleasure, because I kept checking my phone. Well, Forest helps you with that. The app is disarmingly simple: you select a plant and set a timer and...put your phone down. After you successfully did not check your phone, the plant you selected gets planted into your forest. If you fail and check your phone, your plant dies and you have to start over. Your forest grows the more times you set the timer and successfully wait. You also earn points for focusing which you can then use to "buy" (you're using an in-game currency) other cute plants and trees, like a weeping willow or a sunflower. These are really cute and it gives you an incentive to continue focusing. It takes a while to accumulate points which I actually like; it may take you a week or so to unlock a new plant. Alternatively, you have the option to donate your unused points to plant real trees somewhere in the world, which is a great idea. In all, the app has helped me to avoid distractions and that has helped my mental health. I am more intentional with my phone now. I think of what my phone can do for me; otherwise, I set the timer and put it down. The paid version is a one-time purchase of $1.99 and I think it's definitely worth it. You'll unlock more features that make the experience more pleasant. If anyone is struggling to focus because of their phone use, then this app will definitely help you. Go plant a virtual forest!

I know that this is not the main purpose of the app, but I feel like I was misled about what I'd be getting for my premium upgrade.  Edit: To clarify, per the response from the developer: I did pay for the Pro account and was able to "plant" 5 real trees, which is great. text: I like the app because it helps me limit my distractions and resist the temptation to waste time on my phone. However, sometimes I get a call while my tree is growing, and the call kills my tree even though I did not pick up the phone, which is rather unpleaseant. Additionally, sometimes I will get a very important message that I need to respond to, but I cannot because Forest will threaten to kill my tree if I leave the app, which can be inconvenient. I suggest allowing a "pause" feature for these types of situations where a disturbance is quite important. Now, I understand that people may take advantage of the pause feature, thus ruining the very purpose of the app. This is why I suggest a limited number of pauses, likely one or two allowed per day or per week. That way, people with an important call will not kill their trees, and people likely would not abuse the pause feature if they knew they only had one. Otherwise, the app is fairly simple and very useful, and I am mostly satisfied with its performance, thank you.

text: I really do love this app--what a genius idea to turn not using your phone into a game. I don't understand the complaints about the ads because there really aren't that many of them and if you have an Android device you can just press the back button to get out of them.  The two things that I would really like to see going forward are (1) push notifications when your work time or break is over. Its really easy to get lost in a "5-minute" break if there's nothing to warn you that it's over. The same thing goes for the work time, I'd like to have a notification that I completed my time. (2) I would love to have some sort of widget for my home screen for this app. Maybe a representation of how many trees I've planted, how much time I've spent focusing today, or something else similar. I love seeing my little forest at the end of the day, and I look forward to being able to cash in my points for different trees--or even better, real trees somewhere on Earth.  Only thing I haven't figured out is how to edit a past entry. One time I had it set to keep timing after the ding, but I didn't realize it just keeps going until you click something, so it logged a bunch of time I wasn't actually working.  Another thing is that I think you only get to plant real trees if you purchase the paid app. It was only $1.99, and of course eliminates ads as well, so not a big deal, but good to know in advance. You do, however, have to cash in 2500 points to plant a real tree, which takes quite a while to get to (the formula for how they calculate points earned is complex) and any points you spend to get different trees and bushes (500 points each) comes out of the same pot, so you have to decide between getting that cute little cherry blossom (or octopus topiary) and putting much-needed oxygen on Earth. Granted, you could decide to plant trees in your own yard or donate real money to to the organization for every so many minutes you worked, but it's just something to know.

developer_reply:
Hi,
The purchase of Forest made in either iOS or Android is not transferable as Apple and Google sell the apps in their own market. As app developers, we are not in charge of the app-selling process.
You'd need to buy the iOS and Android versions separately, but you'll be able to use the same account on multiple devices on that platform.
- Forest

text: Como puedo utilizar la app ??
author: karol elizabeth cunyarache juarez
developer_reply:
Hi,
Please set your time by dragging the dot that surrounds the circle on the main planting page. Switch tree species by tapping on the tree image inside the circle on the home page. Tap "Plant" to start planting. The trees you've planted will stay in your Forest. When finished, you will gain coins, and you can unlock more trees in the Store.

「Deep Focus Mode」is developed because of the regular update of Android System which makes trees die for no reason or not even wither while user using other app.

We didn't use data for commercial use.

text: Forest has a beautiful design and a useful timer that genuinely blocks other apps, but the gamification feels at odds with the purpose of a focus app. Daily rewards, unlocks and digital collectibles use FOMO to nudge you back. This is not removed with the paid version. If you are trying to reduce phone use and increase your focus, an app should help you put your phone down, not use the same psychological techniques as games and social media. Choose a simpler, privacy-friendly focus app instead.
author: Evelien Smits
developer_reply: Thank you for sharing this thoughtful feedback. We understand your concern that gamification can feel counterproductive when your goal is to reduce phone use. We’ll keep this perspective in mind as we improve Forest. Forest Team

No entanto, o que me entristeceu foi quando decidi entrar no mundo da meditação (que deve ser num curto período para iniciantes) não encontrei um timer de 5 minutos. Isso sem dúvidas atrapalhou o processo da minha floresta eu tive que usar outro app para medir o tempo. text: O app é maravilhoso! Você consegue manter o foco com muita facilidade. Você pode ativar ou desativar o modo foco total. Você vê que é muito mais simples fazer os seus deveres do que o drama que faz na sua cabeça. Tem uma linda variedade de árvores pra você escolher. Você pode se organizar com marcadores como: trabalho, estudo, descanço, outros, indefinido... O tempo minímo de uma atividade é de 10 minutos e o máximo é de 2 horas (dá pra mudar pra 3 nas configurações). INSTALE AGORA MESMO!!!!

developer_reply:
Hi,
Please make sure the "Deep focus mode" is turned on before you plant the tree so that when you go to another app, there should be a full-screen notification that blocks you and tells you to go back to Forest. If that isn't the case, please contact us via android.support@forestapp.cc. We will investigate the problem further. Thank you. :)

text: Fui testar o Forest e me surpreendi, teve uma alta mudança na minha produtividade logo no primeiro dia de uso. Há uma interação que conforme você estuda, uma árvore vai se desenvolvendo e caso você abra outro aplicativo em seu celular ela se desfaz, assim fazendo você manter o foco em apenas uma coisa. Ao longo dos dias, vai se formando uma floresta com cada árvore que foi crescendo no jardim, logo quanto mais foco, mais lindo o jardim fica.

Hi,
Bushes are planted under 20 minutes, and trees are planted over 25 minutes. Set your time by dragging the dot that surrounds the circle on the main planting page. You can switch tree species by tapping on the tree image inside the circle on the home page. Tap "Plant" to start planting. When finished, you will gain coins to unlock more trees.

Since the cost of planting real trees is covered by the company, complications might arise when users plant too many real trees; the cost can also easily exceed the app's revenue. - Forest

HI
Regarding data access, Forest requires permission just to ensure that 「Deep Focus Mode」can run smoothly when users open app not in the whitelist.

「Deep Focus Mode」is developed because of the regular update of Android System which makes trees die for no reason or not even wither while user using other app.

We didn't use data for commercial use.

text: Ótimo aplicativo, esta ajudando bastante no gerenciamento de minhas atividades..... Tenho uma sugestão que é de fácil manutenção e daria mais vontade de adquirir as arvores especificas ..... Cada arvore que é comprada com as moedas poderia ter uma caracteristica de maior tempo... digamos que tem uma arvore que custa 2000 moedas e a vantagem dela é que vc consegue aumentar 4 horas de tempo no uso do app... logo vc ganha mais moedas e consegue adicionar atividades relacionadas a 4 horas ao inves de criar duas arvores de 120 minutos. Por exemplo.... arvore da faculdade ... dura até 4 horas, arvore do sono dura de 6 a 8 horas, arvore do lanche dura 30 minutos. Ideia de arvore do sono: lançar varias arvores com intervalo de tempo diferente arvore do sono curto dura 4 horas arvore do sono do snorlax (pokemon) dura ate 8 horas e por ai vai.
